verdict.line: You win by stacking E-driven Vessel trades near your tentacles and snowballing side pressure; you lose if you facetank his Q poke before level 6 and skip anti-heal into his R sustain.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's skill order (QWEEEREQEQRQQWW) maxes Test of Spirit by level 5, which lets her force repeated Vessel trades that Dr. Mundo cannot win on raw damage — the 53.7% win rate over 123 games and the solo-kill advantage both come from that structural fact. Mundo's answer isn't a trade tool, it's attrition: Infected Cleaver poke plus Adrenaline Rush and Sadism regen, which is why he's hard to outright kill without cutting his healing.

theirWindow.what: Infected Cleaver hits for a percentage of your max health at 975 range on a 4s cooldown and you have no answer to it until E is online — don't stand in lane just to trade minions, back up a step and let tentacles screen you.

yourWindow.what: Rip his spirit with E (Test of Spirit) while standing near terrain your passive has already spawned Tentacles on — the spirit echoes damage back to him and the Tentacles swing at him too, which is exactly the harass loop OP.GG flags for this matchup.

summoners.why: highest measured win rate at the largest sample (54.9% over 63% pick) — Illaoi's tentacle-fueled split push punishes Mundo's lack of a real waveclear or engage answer, and Teleport lets you cash that in across the map.

playing.title: Fight only near tentacle walls
playing.detail: Position your E (Test of Spirit) casts so his spirit stands near terrain where your passive already spawned Tentacles — the echo damage plus Tentacle swings is your core harass loop.

playing.title: Hold trades before level 3
playing.detail: Until E is live you only have Q (10/9/8/7/6s cooldown) and W's 400-range leap; don't absorb his 975-range Q poke for free, since it scales off your max health.

playing.title: Don't linger on low-health Mundo
playing.detail: His E (Masochism) grants bonus AD scaling with missing health, so a drawn-out trade against a low-HP Mundo lets him hit harder — commit to the kill or disengage, don't sit at that threshold.

playing.title: Track his 75s ultimate
playing.detail: R (Sadism) lets him burn health for movement speed and heavy regen to escape or stabilize — an all-in while it's up is wasted tempo, wait for it to be down.

playing.title: Buy anti-heal once he stabilizes
playing.detail: Adrenaline Rush plus Sadism means flat damage stops closing games on him — Spirit Visage or Thornmail is what actually finishes the kill, per the measured matchup read.

playing.title: Chain R into existing Vessels
playing.detail: If E has already turned him into a Vessel, your R (Leap of Faith) hitting him spawns another Tentacle on top of existing pressure — stack this during post-6 all-ins.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Use your [E] to harass often. Dr. Mundo’s abilities overall make it difficult to kill Illaoi. However, his (R) allows him to recover a lot of health, so we recommend purchasing an item that reduces healing.
